patches.name: Glide Trail Customization
patches.description: Allows customizing glide typing trail color (including dynamic Rainbow RGB and Color Wheel), fade speed, thickness, and length.

patches.name: Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback
patches.description: Triggers continuous tactile feedback pulses when the backspace key is held down during repeated deletion.

patches.name: Enter Key Tasker Event
patches.description: Broadcasts an Intent event to Tasker whenever the Enter or IME action key is pressed on Gboard.

patches.name: AMOLED Gboard Settings
patches.description: Applies a pure-black theme to Gboard settings rows and future patch preferences.

patches.name: Gboard Theme Builder
patches.description: Create native Gboard themes and customize key visuals via runtime hooks.

patches.name: Keyboard Icon Packs
patches.description: Apply compatible raster icon packs with per-key icon overrides.

patches.name: Multilingual Suggestion
patches.description: Promotes glide and typing suggestions written in a different script.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs Gboard under its own package name, alongside the stock Gboard that most phones have built in. Off by default: Gboard features that are tied to the stock package name keep working only when the package is left alone. Enabling it requires uninstalling the built-in Gboard first, because a patched copy is not signed with Google's key.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name that differs from com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Changes Gboard's app name and launcher icon. Choose the Parakeet icon (default), Gboard's original icon or one of five other designs. The name also appears in Android's keyboard list.

options.title: App name
options.description: Name shown in the launcher, Android's keyboard list and app information. Leave empty to keep Gboard.

patches.name: Parakeet personal dictionary
patches.description: Lets Parakeet voice typing spell the names and words in the Voice dictionary's voice correction list, including contact names added there. Parakeet favours them while listening and corrects a sound-alike spelling only when a second listen agrees. Switch it on or off under Parakeet voice typing; it needs a 2 MB spelling download. Requires Parakeet voice typing and Rambler personal dictionary.

patches.name: Parakeet voice typing
patches.description: Adds Gboard settings → Voice typing → Parakeet voice typing. After downloading NVIDIA Parakeet (Moondream's Parakeet Ultra or the original TDT v3), the microphone key transcribes on the phone and recognises Dutch, English and 23 more languages per sentence without switching. Gives the patched Gboard the Parakeet launcher icon.

patches.name: Rambler personal dictionary
patches.description: Adds Voice dictionary to Gboard settings → Voice typing, with Gboard's voice correction list: names and words you add, import or export, which Rambler receives with every dictation so it spells them right. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches.name: Rambler contact names
patches.description: Adds your contacts' names to Rambler's voice correction list, so Rambler spells them right. Names you delete from the list are not added again; new contacts are added the next time Rambler starts. Needs Gboard's contacts access, which Gboard asks for when you switch on Contact names. Requires Rambler personal dictionary.

patches.name: Rambler custom instructions
patches.description: Adds Custom instructions to Gboard settings → Voice typing → Rambler. Your text is added to Rambler's own instructions, not a replacement for them: Rambler receives it with every dictation and follows it for style only, such as spelling, punctuation, vocabulary and tone. For example: "Write every number in digits." Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches.name: Rambler cursor-aware editing
patches.description: Rambler also sees the text after the cursor, so spoken edits reach the whole text and dictating in the middle of a text fits in. With text selected, only the selection is sent, so a spoken edit such as "make this more formal" applies to it, and the result is selected again for the next edit. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches.name: Rambler app context
patches.description: Rambler also receives the name of the app you dictate in and the text field's hint, so it can match the tone of a chat, an e-mail or a search, and custom instructions can depend on the app. This tells Google which app you are typing in. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches.name: Rambler stop after silence
patches.description: Rambler stops by itself after 3 seconds without speech and keeps the text, as when you tap ✓. Change the time (3, 5, 8 or 10 seconds) or switch it off under Gboard settings → Voice typing → Rambler → Stop after silence. Requires Rambler voice typing.

patches.name: Rambler voice typing
patches.description: Adds Google's Rambler to Gboard settings → Voice typing, as a choice next to Standard voice typing, which Parakeet voice typing renames to Parakeet. Rambler sends your speech to Google's servers, which turn it into finished text and carry out spoken edits. Standard (Parakeet) stays the default.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description: Bypass Gboard's own APK signature whitelist so a patched, re-signed Gboard can use features that verify the signer, such as themes.

patches.name: Rounded Keyboard Panel
patches.description: Customize which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded, and set the top and bottom radii separately. Applies to whichever theme is active.

patches.name: AMOLED dark keyboard
patches.description: Experimental. Turns Gboard's dark keyboard background pure black instead of Google's grey, including the dynamic theme that follows the wallpaper. Light mode and the light theme stay unchanged.

patches.name: Key Shape Selection
patches.description: Enables Gboard's Key shape option in theme details, so a theme's keys can follow the theme's own shape instead of being forced square.

patches.name: Frosted Glass
patches.description: Add live background blur and custom theme transparency to the keyboard, with separate background and key opacity and an option to extend into the navigation bar. Blur needs Android 12 or newer.

patches.name: G Logo on Spacebar
patches.description: Show a built-in icon or your own PNG, WebP, or JPEG on the spacebar. Keep its original colors or choose a single color, adjust its size, and hide the language label.

patches.name: Custom Theme
patches.description: Import custom ZIP themes from Gboard's own theme screen and browse ready-made theme packs, downloaded on demand and verified by checksum. Adds the INTERNET permission.

patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description: Enables Gboard's Writing tools: proofread, rewrite and tone changes on selected text, in every language and keyboard.

patches.name: Enable OCR / Scan Text
patches.description: Enables Gboard's Scan Text camera entry point and runs it with an OCR engine bundled in the patch, so it works without Play Services. Latin text only.

patches.name: Web Clipboard
patches.description: Add the phone-hosted Web Clipboard with browser sync, pairing, and a Quick Settings Tile.

patches.name: Simple Calculator
patches.description: Type an expression and show a scrollable equation plus its answer in Gboard's suggestion row.

patches.name: Incognito Mode Toggle
patches.description: Add an Incognito toggle to the Access Point toolbar and configure clipboard and voice typing availability while Incognito mode is active.

patches.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches.description: Enhance clipboard retention time, item count limit, preview lines, countdown/creation time labels, order index, and column count.

patches.name: Cursor trackpad mode
patches.description: Long-press the space bar to use cursor trackpad and lock modes.

patches.name: Toolbar Editing Buttons
patches.description: Add Select All, Copy, Cut and Paste to the menu.

patches.name: Access Points menu style
patches.description:
切換新版或舊版 Access Points 選單樣式
Switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description:
啟用進階語音輸入（包含自動標點功能），並另外為不支援進階語音輸入的繁體中文語音啟用自動標點
Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation, and separately enable automatic punctuation for Traditional Chinese voice typing, which does not support Advanced Voice Typing.

patches.name: Backup & Restore
patches.description:
匯出或還原全部 Patches 設定，並備份、比較及還原 Gboard PB/XML flag store
Export or restore all Patches settings, and back up, compare, or restore the Gboard PB/XML flag store.

patches.name: Change emoji size
patches.description:
變更表情符號大小
Change emoji size.

patches.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches.description:
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數
Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item.

patches.name: Close Proactive Suggestions
patches.description:
在主動建議列顯示關閉按鈕
Show a dismiss button in the proactive suggestions bar.

patches.name: Custom Symbols
patches.description:
新增獨立的特殊符號分頁，長按逗號->愛心
Add a dedicated custom symbols tab and replace the long-press comma entry with a heart shortcut.

patches.name: Developer options
patches.description:
啟用 開發人員選項 與 Flag 編輯器，你可以自己修改Flag的值
Enable Developer options and the Flag Editor, allowing you to modify flag values.

patches.name: Dictionaries & Predictions
patches.description:
可選擇字典、預測及輸入修正的資源版本
Choose resource versions for dictionaries, predictions, and input correction.

patches.name: Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard「Emojis, stickers & GIFs」底部 tabs 的排序，支援拖曳調整
Customize the bottom tab order in Gboard's Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel with drag-and-drop reordering.

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用內嵌自動填入建議
Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions

patches.name: Enable accessibility layout
patches.description:
啟用無障礙鍵盤配置
Enable accessibility layout.

patches.name: Enable split keyboard
patches.description:
啟用分離式鍵盤
Enable the split keyboard layout.

patches.name: FTP Server
patches.description:
新增區域網路 FTP 伺服器，支援檔案瀏覽、傳輸與下載續傳
Add a LAN FTP server with file browsing, transfers, and download resume.

patches.name: Floating Web Search
patches.description:
直接從 Gboard 開啟懸浮網頁，快速搜尋需要的資訊。
Open a floating web page directly from Gboard to quickly search for the information you need.

patches.name: Grammar Checker
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 文法檢查
Enable Text correction > Grammar check.

patches.name: Inline Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 智慧撰寫
Enable Text correction > Smart Compose.

patches.name: Keypress Vibration Intensity Control
patches.description:
將按鍵震動由持續時間改為力度控制。
Control keypress vibration intensity instead of duration.

patches.name: Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval
patches.description:
新增英文鍵盤地球鍵忽略時間覆寫，可獨立控制輸入後切語言延遲
Add an independent English globe key ignore interval override for post-typing language-switch delay.

patches.name: Long-Press Editing Shortcuts
patches.description:
在英文 QWERTY 與注音鍵盤加入全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做長按快捷鍵
Add Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo long-press shortcuts to English QWERTY and Zhuyin.

patches.name: Quick Insert
patches.description:
啟用快速插入面板與工具列入口
Enable the Quick Insert panel and toolbar access point.

patches.name: Settings Homepage Override
patches.description:
允許切換新版或舊版 Gboard 設定頁面
Allow switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings pages.

patches.name: Swipe Down to Dismiss Keyboard
patches.description:
從建議列或工具列向下滑動以關閉鍵盤。
Swipe down from the suggestions or toolbar to close the keyboard.

patches.name: Swipeable Custom Top Row
patches.description:
滑動鍵盤第一排，在原生列與可自訂文字/JavaScript 列之間切換
Swipe the keyboard top row to switch between the stock row and a customizable text/JavaScript row.

patches.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard 頂端工具列項目數量
Customize the Gboard top toolbar item count.

patches.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches.description:
啟用 語音輸入 -> 使用藍芽麥克風
Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches.name: Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes
patches.description:
調整注音鍵盤底排按鍵大小
Adjust Zhuyin keyboard bottom-row key sizes.

patches.name: Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle
patches.description:
注音 ㄥ 上滑快速切換繁簡
Swipe up on Zhuyin ㄥ to quickly toggle Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

patches.name: Zhuyin Slide Input
patches.description:
注音鍵盤支持上下滑輸入
Enable slide-up and slide-down input on the Zhuyin keyboard.

patches.name: Block App Hijacking
patches.description: Protects against other apps hijacking Gboard and removes debug tools.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Stops background metrics, event logging and crash reporting.

options.title: Block ad servers
options.description: Also blocks Google ad servers. Turn off to keep them.

patches.name: Disable Cloud Backup
patches.description: Keeps keyboard data off Google Drive backups.

patches.name: Disable Play Services
patches.description: Runs without Google Play services. Also turns off inline Translate.

patches.name: Keyboard Settings
patches.description: Adds a settings screen inside Gboard: theme, vibration, clipboard and more.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Fully disconnects Gboard. Download dictionaries first.

patches.name: Remove Extra Files
patches.description: Deletes licenses, tutorial animations and junk.

patches.name: Remove Permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions you pick below.

options.title: Contacts
options.description: Removes contact access (no contact name suggestions).

options.title: Photos & files
options.description: Removes photo access (no custom image themes).

patches.name: Remove Translate Limit
patches.description: Removes the character limit for inline translation.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background downloads and sync to save battery.

patches.name: Stop Remote Updates
patches.description: Stops Google from changing settings remotely.

patches.name: Emoji Key On Right
patches.description: Moves the dedicated emoji key from the left of the spacebar to just left of the enter / search key.

patches.name: English QWERTY Flick Case
patches.description:
英文 QWERTY 鍵盤上滑大寫、下滑小寫
Flick up for uppercase and flick down for lowercase on the English QWERTY keyboard. Flicking down also overrides auto-capitalization.

patches.name: Field adaptation
patches.description: Adjusts suggestions and auto-correct to the field being edited (search, URL, email, password, code). Key size and glide sensitivity are not touched.

patches.name: Glass Panel
patches.description: Turns the translucent keyboard panel into glass, with the system's own glass material on vivo OriginOS and lit edges and a sheen elsewhere. Keys are left as they are. Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass.

patches.name: Glass Press Effect
patches.description: Adds vivo-style liquid glass touch feedback: a soft light blooms out from your finger across the keyboard background, and the keys around your finger dip and spring back.

patches.name: Immersive Keyboard
patches.description: Extends the keyboard under the camera cutout in landscape instead of leaving an empty strip beside it.

patches.name: Key Mapper Watchdog
patches.description: Uses Shizuku to restart Key Mapper's Expert Mode system bridge when it stops. Lets Gboard run shell commands, so only use it if you want this.

patches.name: Per-app profiles
patches.description: Apply a per-app profile to the keyboard: incognito (no learning) and no suggestions for apps listed in the local rule table, plus a toolbar order and a theme or keyboard height written through Gboard's own toolbar editor and additional_keyboard_theme preference. Several rules can be kept and cleared from Gboard's settings as a package=tokens list, next to the single rule. A session override can be set for the app in focus and lasts until another app is focused.

patches.name: Smart bar case swipe
patches.description: Swipe up on a suggested word to capitalize it, or swipe down to lowercase it before it is inserted.

patches.name: Spacebar double-tap tab/undo
patches.description: Double tap the left half of the spacebar to insert a tab, the right half to undo the last edit.

patches.name: Swipe Left to Delete
patches.description:
向左滑動鍵盤即為退格鍵，滑動時逐字刪除，持續按住則改為逐詞刪除。
Sliding left anywhere on the keyboard acts as backspace and deletes characters while you drag; keep holding to delete whole words.

patches.name: Theme Follows Dark Mode
patches.description: Adds a "Light & dark pair" menu to the top of Gboard's Themes screen, so the keyboard switches theme when the system dark mode changes. It can switch the wallpaper between a light and a dark image too.

patches.name: Translucent Bottom Bar
patches.description: Makes the bar under the keyboard (behind the globe and close buttons) match the keyboard's color, opacity and blur, for use with transparent themes such as Frosted Glass.

patches.name: iOS QWERTY layout
patches.description: Puts the globe key of the letter keyboards at the bottom left, where it is on the Japanese 12-key keyboards, and lays out the English symbol keyboard like the iOS "123" and "#+=" pages. Gboard's number row setting keeps working.

patches.name: iOS flick layout
patches.description: Changes the Japanese 12-key keyboard to the layout of iOS with "flick only" enabled: 123, ABC and あいう keys and the globe key on the left, and backspace, space and a two-row enter key on the right.

patches.name: Punctuation spacing
patches.description: Deletes the space Gboard leaves before punctuation that the language sets tight against the word, so a typed "." after "Hey " commits as "Hey.".
